# `schedule` commands

## `schedule calendar`

The calendar for a day, a work week or a month, for one employee ("what is Dave doing tomorrow?"), one customer:job, or everyone: schedule entries and work orders' scheduled times with their assignees, by day, each with any double-booking.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | customer-work |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.calendar` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow schedule calendar --employee "Casey Worker" --view day --date 2026-10-26 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "schedule calendar", "input": {"employee": "Casey Worker", "view": "day", "date": "2026-10-26"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `employee` | `--employee` | string \| null | no | yes | null | One employee's calendar. |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | One customer:job's calendar. |
| `view` | `--view` | literal["day", "week", "month"] | no | no | "week" | — |
| `date` | `--date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Any day in the period; today by default. |
| `include_cancelled` | `--include-cancelled` | boolean | no | no | false | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.calendar`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

## `schedule cancel`

Cancel a schedule entry with a reason; it stays readable.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | customer-work |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.cancel` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

## `schedule create`

Put an employee on a customer:job, or on a work order, from a company-local start to an end (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), with notes. Double-booking the employee -- another entry or a scheduled work order they are assigned to, overlapping -- saves with a warning naming it. Posts nothing and records no time.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | customer-work |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow schedule create --employee "Casey Worker" --customer "Riverside Apartments" --starts 2026-10-26T08:00 --ends 2026-10-26T12:00 --notes "Water heater" --reason "Book the install" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "schedule create", "input": {"employee": "Casey Worker", "customer": "Riverside Apartments", "starts": "2026-10-26T08:00", "ends": "2026-10-26T12:00", "notes": "Water heater"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `employee` | `--employee` | string | yes | no | — | Employee ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Customer:job; or name a work order instead. |
| `work_order` | `--work-order` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Work order ID or number; its customer:job is the job. |
| `starts` | `--starts` | string | yes | no | — | Company-local start, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.; minimum length 16; maximum length 16 |
| `ends` | `--ends` | string | yes | no | — | Company-local end, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, after the start.; minimum length 16; maximum length 16 |
| `notes` | `--notes` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

## `schedule update`

Move or reassign a schedule entry: name only what changes. Overlaps are warned about.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | customer-work |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow schedule update 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 1 --starts 2026-10-26T13:00 --ends 2026-10-26T16:00 --reason "Customer asked for the afternoon" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "schedule update", "input": {"entry": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "expected_version": 1, "starts": "2026-10-26T13:00", "ends": "2026-10-26T16:00"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entry` | `ENTRY` | string | yes | no | — | Schedule entry ID.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `employee` | `--employee` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `work_order` | `--work-order` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Work order; null takes the entry off its work order. |
| `starts` | `--starts` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `ends` | `--ends` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `notes` | `--notes` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/schedule.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |
